title: Hatred Stems from Ignorance! Distillation of the Persuasion Modes in Countering Conversational Hate Speech
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the persuasion modes (reason, emotion, credibility) used in hate speech and counterspeech concerning religious bigotry.
findings: In countering religious bigotry, humans overwhelmingly use reason-based persuasion (94-96%). Generative models also favor reason for this topic, but to a lesser extent and with more use of emotion compared to humans. Counterspeech on religious bigotry, along with sexism, utilizes credibility-based persuasion (e.g., recounting personal stories) more frequently than counterspeech on racism.
